capabilities: Edit style properties of embedded SVG files (color, border, opacity)
Save changed styles in-place into the original SVG file
Save a styled copy of the SVG as a duplicate
Clear existing styles from an SVG
Target drawable tags: path, line, rect, circle, ellipse, polygon
disambiguation: Not an image editor for raster files; it only changes style properties of embedded SVG files.
extras: The README only lists tags it supports for styling and does not explain how style values are chosen or previewed before saving.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to restyle an embedded SVG file, such as recoloring an icon used in a note.
summary: SVG style editor that changes color, border, opacity and other style properties of embedded SVG files from the command palette.
